name: sealed-pair
description: MCP tools for the Sealed Pair sealed P2P OTC dApp on Sui — read open RFQ orders, verify settlement digests, look up maker reputation. Stack with Tatum's official MCP for general-purpose Sui RPC access.

tools.name: list_open_orders
tools.description: List the most recent sealed RFQ orders. Returns orderId, blobId, pair, side, sizeBand, maker, expiry, escrow.

tools.name: wallet_history
tools.description: Tatum Data API surface — recent transaction blocks for any Sui address via suix_queryTransactionBlocks. Returns digest, timestamp, gas used, status.

tools.name: verify_settle_digest
tools.description: Confirm a Sui tx digest emitted OrderSettled from the deployed sealed_pair::order package.

tools.name: maker_stats
tools.description: Aggregate on-chain stats (posted, settled, cancelled, success rate, tier) for a maker address.

tatum-official.description: Tatum's official MCP server for general Sui (and 100+ chain) RPC access. Compose alongside sealed-pair tools for the broadest blockchain coverage in one config. Requires your own Tatum API key set in the TATUM_API_KEY env variable BEFORE starting your MCP client — if unset, omit this server entry to avoid noisy 401s from upstream.

notes: All sealed-pair tools are read-only and route through Tatum's Sui RPC gateway with server-side API key custody.
Mutations (create_offer, lock_with_escrow, settle, cancel_open, cancel_expired) require wallet signing and are not exposed.
GET /api/mcp returns the live tool catalog with full JSON schemas.
Compose 'sealed-pair-http' + 'tatum-official' in your MCP client to give an AI agent both Sealed Pair semantics AND raw Tatum RPC access.
